messages:
Priya: quick check — handoff plan for compliance milestone: we need clear owners for KMS/HSM evidence + audit-log ingest. Targeting handoff Wed EOD. Who's owning what? :wave:

Jin: infra here. we own keystore integration + install of audit-agent. staging cutover scheduled Tue. blocker = PR to add log-forwarder config (still open). I can take install coordination / schedule.

Alex: runtime: can own the audit-log ingest pipeline work (validation + fallback). I'll pick up the PR review for the log-forwarder today (#432). will confirm by EOD if no conflicts.

Maria: compliance: missing artifacts for control mappings (esp. key rotation evidence). also need the HSM attestation doc in final form. can someone drop the Confluence link?

Priya: thanks. rotation policy + attestation draft here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/kms-rotation (still draft). I'll upload the exported pdf snapshot to the evidence bucket once we sign off.

Sam: I can be primary owner for “auditlog ingestion” from product side — will coordinate acceptance criteria. depends on infra scheduling tho. @Jin can you book a maintenance window and a post-deploy smoke test with eng-sre?

Jin: yep — Thurs 1011am PST works for me. will ping eng-oncall and create a runbook snippet:

```
steps:
 - deploy agent to staging
 - run ingest smoke test (10k events)
 - confirm retention metadata stored in s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/auditlogs/
 - snapshot config and upload to evidence bucket
```

Alex: note: runtime needs a small change to avoid double-kv-writes during cutover — I'll attach the patch in the PR. cc @Maria for compliance impact.

Maria: ack. if patch changes retention metadata format, we need to record that in the control evidence and add a note in the matrix.

sec-bot: reminder: fieldwork window opens Mon 2024-06-03. please ensure evidence artifacts are uploaded 48h before.

Priya: action items recap: 
• Jin: schedule Thurs window + runbook (in progress)
• Alex: review/merge #432 + attach patch (today)
• Sam: define acceptance criteria doc (by Tue)
• Maria: confirm attestation doc + evidence upload (by Wed)
I'll update the handoff checklist and post the evidence links here when available. thanks! :thumbsup:
